blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) policies write a reasoning trace and then decode the action from it. A wrong trace yields a wrong action, and even a correct-looking trace can mislead the plan. Existing remedies ask whether the reasoning is right. We ask how strongly it should steer. CoC-CFG applies classifier-free guidance between the policy's context and the same context without the reasoning span. One weight per Euler step attenuates or amplifies the reasoning, and w=1 recovers the original policy. We treat the choice of this weight as a Markov decision process whose action values are measured, not bootstrapped. With the expert frozen and the noise fixed, applying a weight for one step and finishing the plan under the current controller returns that weight's value exactly. Q-adaptive guidance fits these values with small critics and improves the controller conservatively. In the Alpasim driving simulator it outperforms every fixed weight and online RL (SAC, GRPO) in open loop, and in closed loop it passes 262 of 300 scenes, against 252 for the original policy. On held-out frames of the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, its first three stages outperform every fixed weight, four adaptive-guidance methods, SAC and GRPO. On the hidden test set, a frozen Alpamayo 1.5 with rule-based camera and vehicle conversions and Q-adaptive guidance sets a new state of the art among published methods: 8.135159 rater feedback score, against 8.079 for the best published method.
blocks.zh: 理性视觉-语言-行动(VLA)政策写出推理追踪,然后从中解码动作. 错误的踪迹会产生错误的行动,甚至正确的目光也会误导计划. 现有补救办法询问推理是否正确。 我们问,它应如何有力地指导。 CoC-CFG在不设推理跨度的情况下,在政策上下文和同一上下文之间适用无分类器指导. 每欧勒一克会削弱或放大推理,而w=1则会恢复原来的政策. 我们把这种权重的选择当作一个马可夫决定过程,它的动作值是被测量的,而不是被拖出. 随着专家被冻结,噪音被固定,一个步骤应用了权重,然后在目前的控制器下完成计划,准确返回权重值. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision–language–action (VLA) models increasingly reason before they act: a
vision–language model (VLM) writes a reasoning trace, and an action expert
decodes the action conditioned on it [ 23 , 38 , 11 ] . In the Alpamayo
driving planners [ 23 ] , the VLM writes a Chain-of-Causation
(CoC) into its key–value cache, and a flow-matching expert decodes the
trajectory from that cache in a few Euler steps. The trace is not a caption but
part of the condition: editing it moves the trajectory [ 22 ] .

The obvious fixes ask whether the reasoning is right. Alpamayo 1.5 is already
post-trained with reinforcement learning for reasoning–action consistency [ 23 ] , and its traces still err; detecting hallucinations
remains unsolved, at 0.51 IoU for the best system of a recent
shared task [ 29 ] , and a detector only keeps or drops the
trace. Neither helps when the trace reads correctly yet misleads the plan.

We ask instead how strongly the trace should steer. CoC-CFG ,
Chain-of-Causation classifier-free guidance [ 10 ] , runs
the frozen expert on the policy’s own context and on the same context with only
the reasoning span removed, and moves each Euler step along the line through the
two velocities. The position on that line, the guidance
weight w k w_{k} , sets how strongly the trace steers step k k : w k = 1 w_{k}{=}1 is the
unmodified model, lower weights attenuate the trace and higher weights amplify it
(Fig. How Much Should a VLA Trust Its Reasoning? Step-Level Guidance as a Measured Action-Value Function a). Trusting and rejecting the trace are two points on this
axis.

blocks.en:
The weight acts before the plan exists, so we treat its choice as a Markov
decision process over the Euler steps whose only reward is the score of the
finished plan (Sec. 4 ). Because the expert is frozen and the noise fixed,
generation is deterministic and can be reset to any step: applying one weight
for one step and finishing the plan under the current controller returns that
weight’s value exactly. Learning becomes supervised regression on measured
values, where online reinforcement learning would bootstrap what can be
measured. Q-adaptive guidance (Fig. 2 ) fits small critics to these measurements with a cost
for leaving a reference weight, re-measures under the improved controller and
refits on every measurement so far.

In Alpasim, a driving simulator reconstructed from real drives, the controller
lowers the open-loop displacement cost of Alpamayo 1.5 by 16.5 %
against w = 1 w{=}1 , above soft actor-critic (SAC) and group-relative policy
optimization (GRPO) trained on the same signal, and passes 262 of
300 closed-loop scenes against 252 (Sec. 5.1 ).
On the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark [ 32 ] , its first three
stages clear every fixed weight, four adaptive-guidance methods, SAC and GRPO
on the held-out frames, and Alpamayo 1.5,
converted to the Waymo vehicle by rule-based conversions and steered by Q-adaptive
guidance, sets a new state of the art among published methods on the hidden
test set: 8.135159 rater feedback score (RFS) against
8.079 (Sec. 5.2 ).

blocks.en:
Our contributions are three.
(i) CoC-CFG , a guidance axis over the reasoning span of a VLA’s
context that attenuates or amplifies the trace and is exact at w = 1 w{=}1 : an
unreliable trace becomes an influence to control rather than a defect to detect.
(ii) Step-level guidance as a Markov decision process with measured
action values , each obtained by a one-step branch, and Q-adaptive
guidance , a controller that chooses the weight at every Euler step from critics
fitted to these values.
(iii) Evidence on a frozen driving VLA : open-loop gains in Alpasim
above fixed weights and online RL, closed-loop gains over fixed weights,
held-out Waymo gains over fixed weights, adaptive-guidance methods and online RL, and
a new state of the art among published methods on the hidden test set of the
Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Classifier-free guidance [ 10 ] carries over to flow matching [ 19 ] ; schedules [ 15 ] and learned or
searched per-step weights [ 8 , 21 , 24 ] assume a trusted condition, whereas ours is the measured value of acting on a
condition that can be wrong.
blocks.zh:
无分类指导 [10] 结转到匹配 [19]; 调度 [15] 和学到或
搜索的每步加权数 [8, 21, 24] 假设一个可信任的条件, 而我们的值是按
条件可能是错误的。

blocks.en:
Denoising is a Markov decision process with a terminal reward [ 1 ] , steered by the
gradient of a soft value [ 28 ] or by soft value-based
selection among candidates [ 17 ] ; our controller is the discrete,
one-dimensional member of this family (Sec. 3 ), with a measured value. The fit is a
one-step advantage [ 2 ] (Sec. 4 ), conservatism comes from a
cost for departing from a reference weight, as in conservative policy iteration [ 13 ] , and
the one-step branches are “vine” rollouts [ 26 ] .

软值的梯度 [28] 或以软值为基础的梯度

此家族的一维成员(Sec. 3),具有测量值. 体型是一个
一步优势[2](第4节),保守主义来自a
偏离参考权重的费用,如保守政策迭代[13],以及

fixed, so the same state and weights give the same plan. It is resettable : a stored latent restores the generation at any step. On a
training scene, where the scoring reference is known, the value of applying a a at s k s_{k} and then following a fixed controller π \pi is therefore measured, not
estimated: a one-step branch applies a a for one step, finishes the plan

the controller is supervised regression on measured values. Online

gradient [ 27 ] credits one score to a whole schedule of K K decisions, and a soft actor-critic [ 9 ] bootstraps a
critic toward values that can be measured exactly (Sec. 5.1 compares the three).

blocks.en: 5.2 Waymo End-to-End Driving

blocks.en:
The Waymo Open Dataset end-to-end driving benchmark [ 32 , 30 ] poses vision-based planning on
long-tail scenarios. Its rater feedback score (RFS) is the mean of eleven
per-category scores of a plan against trajectories rated by humans. Of
478 scored validation frames, 358 are held out for
every controller comparison and 120 supply training data; the
organizers score the hidden test set. Alpamayo 1.5 [ 23 ] decodes
its trajectory in K = 10 K{=}10 Euler steps. It is trained on a camera
rig and a vehicle unlike Waymo’s, so rule-based conversions map Waymo’s camera
images into its camera geometry and its plan onto the Waymo vehicle. The VLM
and the expert stay frozen; the anchor is the default w = 1 w{=}1 .

The late disagreement , the distance between the latents of the constant w = 1 w{=}1 and w = 0 w{=}0 rollouts entering the last Euler step, exists only after
both have run. A receding-horizon rule obtains it at decision time: at every
Euler step it rolls candidate schedules ahead and keeps w = 1 w{=}1 unless the
reasoning’s exposure on the last steps would exceed a calibrated limit.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
What matters is not whether to trust a VLA’s trace but how strongly it steers. CoC-CFG makes that a control axis inside flow matching, and the frozen,
resettable generator gives each step’s weight a measured value. Q-adaptive
guidance learns from these measurements; on Alpamayo 1.5 it outperforms every fixed weight and online
RL in Alpasim open loop, passes the most closed-loop scenes, and sets a new
state of the art among published methods on the Waymo end-to-end driving
benchmark.
blocks.zh:
关键不是信任志愿军的踪迹, CoC-CFG使控制轴在流内匹配 冷冻
重置的生成器会给每个步骤的重量一个测量值。 Q 适应性
指导从这些测量中汲取教训;在阿尔帕马约1.5上,它的表现超过了每个固定重量和在线。
Alpasim 的 RL 开放循环, 通过最闭合的镜头, 设置新
关于Waymo端对端驾驶的公布方法中的最新技术
基准。
